spanish: Y si voto o ofrenda voluntaria sacrificio su ofrenda, en día de su acercar su sacrificio será comido, y desde mañana, y lo restante desde él será comido.

findings.issue: Preposition suffix is 1st person common plural (from us); Spanish uses 3rd masculine singular él.

notes: Remaining tokens match, including the verbless opening, hiphil infinitive, both niphal imperfects, and the repeated conjunctions.
